dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000q0w7](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000q0w7) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 68.077 depth occurred on May 22 2025 24km S of Bengkulu. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -4.0046 longitude 102.2903. It impacted 160576 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
